notes.title: Milestone 0.2
notes.content:
With milestone 0.2 the entire magic system is updated. Here the list of features and bugfixes.

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*] 10 different Spells, depending on the class you choose.
[*] AI can now use magic, so be prepared to get attacked by enemy magicians.
[*] All magic spells now have sounds
[*] You gain also mana if you level up
[*] Level up restores your mana
[*] Character now have matching spells to their class and mana (probably not final)
[*] Characters on fight scren will continue attack animation after the own attack is done but they still get attacked by enemy units.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Re-Adjusted magic UI, because longer texts didn't fit.
[*] End screen did not compute money correct, if you hit "next level" before the animation was done.
[*] If you ended Level 7 by killing the boss, you did not the artefact.
[*] Overworld magic animation did not loop.
[/list]

tags.feature: 10 different Spells, depending on the class you choose.
AI can now use magic, so be prepared to get attacked by enemy magicians.
All magic spells now have sounds
You gain also mana if you level up
Level up restores your mana
Character now have matching spells to their class and mana (probably not final)
Characters on fight scren will continue attack animation after the own attack is done but they still get attacked by enemy units.

tags.bug: Re-Adjusted magic UI, because longer texts didn't fit.
End screen did not compute money correct, if you hit "next level" before the animation was done.
If you ended Level 7 by killing the boss, you did not the artefact.
Overworld magic animation did not loop.
